about.description:
I chose Applied Computer Science with a specialization in APP/AI because I am fascinated by how data and algorithms can solve complex real-world problems. I build robust backend architectures (C#, Python, Java) and modern user interfaces (React, Tailwind).

Beyond coding, I am passionate about football and fitness, which keep me disciplined, and I love traveling to discover new cultures. My ultimate dream is to become a Lead AI/Backend Engineer, creating intelligent systems that make a tangible difference. Oh, and I also pride myself on my soft skills: I am a proactive problem-solver and a strong Agile team player.

experience.sectionSubText: What I have done so far

woonboog.title: VBA Developer & IT Support
points: Developed an automated VBA application within Excel to calculate property profitability (rent vs. sell) based on dynamic parameters like the number of bathrooms.
Transformed complex manual spreadsheets into intuitive, user-friendly dashboards with automated graphs and clear visual indicators (red/green) to assist decision-making.
Hired as a student worker following a successful one-month internship to finalize and deploy the financial application.
Provided active IT Helpdesk support, resolving daily technical issues for employees and assisting with office infrastructure.

projects.description: The following projects showcase my skills and experience through real-world examples. Each project is briefly described with links to code repositories and live demos where available. They reflect my ability to solve complex problems, work with modern technologies, and manage projects effectively from analysis to deployment.

chez_natalie.name: B&B Chez Natalie (System Design)
chez_natalie.description: Led the preliminary track (analysis and design) for a B&B management system. Translated business requirements into detailed Use Case Diagrams, designed a robust relational Data Model (ERD), and created high-fidelity interactive prototypes in Figma applying strict Agile methodologies.

feest_op_tafel.name: Feest Op Tafel
feest_op_tafel.description: Collaborative SKIL2 project developing a comprehensive web application for a client. Built with the TALL stack, integrating Stripe for secure payments and Chart.js for data visualization. Applied strict Scrum methodologies to deliver a fully functional, production-ready Proof of Concept.

evently.name: Evently
evently.description: A comprehensive web application serving as a central hub for event organizers and participants. Features role-based access control, full CRUD operations, image uploads, server-side validation, and multi-language support built entirely on the TALL stack and Livewire 3.

tour_de_france.name: Tour de France Data Analysis
tour_de_france.description: Data Science project exploring the rich history of the Tour de France. Involved complex web scraping with BeautifulSoup, rigorous data cleaning, and insightful analysis of winner nationalities, ages, and race lengths. Visualized historical trends and records using Python, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
